The HWPX renewal playbook update succeeded in its first iteration, achieving a perfect verifier reward through successful pytest execution.
The run achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.81, with all tests passing in 4m 38s. The pytest suite 'test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite' confirmed the fix, though the 0.81 judge reward suggests potential for further optimization in the renewal logic. Results were successfully serialized to result.json in the experiment directory.
